app.name: PDF Duplex Batch Printer
queue.empty.pdfs.title: No PDFs
queue.empty.pdfs.detail: Add PDF files to create a sequential print queue.
queue.empty.images.title: No Images
queue.empty.images.detail: Add images in the order you want them printed.
queue.dropHint: Tip: drag files from Finder onto this window. Swipe left to delete, drag ⠿ to reorder.
settings.title: Shared Print Settings
settings.description.shared: One printer and profile are applied to every odd and even pass in this batch.
settings.description.imagesSingle: Images print in list order, one image per sheet, using one shared printer profile.
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Profile name
state.completed.detail: Every non-skipped file has completed both passes.
state.cancelled.detail: No additional print passes will be submitted.
idle.pdfs.perFile: Files are processed one at a time: odd pages → flip → even pages → next file.
idle.pdfs.combined: All files print odd pages in one run → flip once → all even pages. Each file starts on a new sheet, so the stack separates into sets.
idle.images.single: Images print in list order, one one-sided job per image.
idle.images.double: The image list is treated as pages: odd pages → flip → even pages.
flip.title: Odd pages finished
notification.flip.body: Turn the stack over and reinsert it, then return to the app to print the even pages.
calibration.title: Manual Duplex Calibration
calibration.intro: Calibration records how this printer outputs and accepts the paper stack. Do it once per printer/profile, then use that profile for every PDF in the batch.
flip.instruction.long: Turn the whole printed stack over and reinsert it for long edge binding. Do not re-sort the sheets, then continue.
flip.instruction.short: Turn the whole printed stack over and reinsert it for short edge binding. Do not re-sort the sheets, then continue.
flip.instruction.rotate.long: Turn the whole printed stack over, rotate it 180°, then reinsert it for long edge binding. Do not re-sort the sheets, then continue.
flip.instruction.rotate.short: Turn the whole printed stack over, rotate it 180°, then reinsert it for short edge binding. Do not re-sort the sheets, then continue.
flip.note.lastPageBlank: The document has {{pages}} pages, so the sheet with page {{pages}} gets a blank back. Keep it in the stack.
flip.note.combinedBlank: Files with an odd page count end with a blank back so the next file starts on a new sheet. Keep every sheet in the stack.
calibration.step1.detail: The four pages are marked FRONT/BACK and show the top edge.
calibration.created: Saved to {{path}} and added to the PDF queue.
calibration.step2: 2. Print and reinsert the test stack
calibration.step2.detail: Print the test PDF from the PDF queue. After the odd pass, turn the whole stack over and reinsert it without re-sorting. Adjust the settings below until page 2 is behind page 1 and page 4 is behind page 3, both upright.
queue.missingHint: Some files can no longer be found. Remove them before printing.
error.pdf.emptyImageList: Add at least one image before printing.
error.pdf.cannotCreatePage: Cannot create a blank PDF page.
error.cups.noJobID: The print system did not return a job ID: {{response}}
error.windows.sumatraMissing: SumatraPDF was not found. Reinstall the app, or set the SUMATRA_PDF environment variable to SumatraPDF.exe.
error.batch.stopping: The previous batch is still stopping. Try again in a moment.
error.batch.missingFiles: Some files can no longer be found. Remove them before printing.
